misprints.note: κ is missing in the print (checked at higher magnification). Kept as printed.

uncertain.note: Running head. I removed the OCR's leading '~' and the ')' after 42 to match the print. How headers are formatted varies across the strips.
The italic abbreviation looks like υυ/νυ. I wrote it as Swedish 'vv.' (also in 0046_04, 'o. gm vv.'). Other pages are not consistent here.
The ending accents are small. I read a breathing plus a circumflex, which matches how endings are printed elsewhere in the book, but it could be ῶσα, ῶν.
The breathing on υ is ambiguous; it could be the rough breathing (αὑτοῦ). It looks smooth to me.
The mark after ἀπόδειξις is faint. It is a full stop, possibly a comma.
